card.essence: Silica is the remedy for defective assimilation and imperfect nutrition leading to chronic weakness, suppuration, and fibrotic change. The patient is chilly, sweaty (especially head), oversensitive mentally and physically, and lacks vital stamina—yet can perform when forced. It ripens abscesses, absorbs scar tissue, and promotes expulsion of foreign bodies. Scrofulous children with large heads, open fontanelles, and weak ankles typify its picture.

keynotes.text: Imperfect assimilation despite adequate food; defective nutrition
Lack of vital heat; always chilly, hugs fire, worse in winter
Profuse, offensive sweat of head extending to neck
Open fontanelles and sutures; large head; distended abdomen; slow to walk
Suppurative processes: ripens abscesses, promotes expulsion of foreign bodies
Unhealthy skin: every little injury suppurates
Yielding, faint-hearted; wants to shirk; dreads failure yet performs well when forced
Stool partly expelled then recedes again; great straining as if rectum paralysed
Constipation always before and during menses
Headache from occiput over head to eyes; worse uncovering head, better wrapping warmly
Ill effects of vaccination: abscesses, convulsions
Fistulae: fistula in ano, lachrymal duct, breast; all fistulous burrowings
Fixed ideas: thinks only of pins, fears them, counts them

mentals: Yielding, faint-hearted, anxious; wants to give up
Nervous, excitable, oversensitive to all impressions
Dread of failure; fears undertaking anything yet does well when forced
Brain-fag from mental labour; reading and writing fatigue
Obstinate, headstrong children who cry when spoken to kindly
Irritable when aroused, but timid and retiring when left alone
physicals: Scrofulous, rachitic children: large head, open fontanelles, weak ankles, distended abdomen
Profuse, offensive head sweat extending to neck
Suppuration slow, persistent; thin, watery, foul-smelling pus
Abscesses, boils, carbuncles, fistulae; promotes ripening and expulsion
Constipation: stool recedes after partial expulsion; great straining
Headache from occiput to eyes (right); as if from spine
Vertigo ascending from nape; worse looking up
Sweat of hands, feet, axillae offensive
Crippled nails on fingers and toes
Takes cold from exposure of feet
clinical: Scrofulous and rachitic children with defective assimilation
Fistulae: in ano, lachrymal duct, breast, all fistulous tracts
Suppurative glandular swellings (cervical, axillary, parotid, mammary, inguinal)
Chronic suppurative processes; promotes maturation or reduces excessive suppuration
Removal of foreign bodies: splinters, needles, fish bones, imbedded missiles
Keloid and fibrotic tissue: stimulates absorption of scar tissue and indurations
Complaints of stonecutters with loss of strength
Corneal ulcers, iritis with pus in anterior chamber
Slow recovery after pneumonia; chronic lung complaints (use with caution in advanced phthisis)

differentials.note: Both sweaty-headed children, but Calc is fat, torpid, obesic; Silicea is thin, over-sensitive, imperfectly nourished with shrunken limbs
Hepar expedites discharge of pus already formed; Silicea comes later for healing after discharge, or to ripen indolent abscesses
Silicea is the chronic of Puls; both yielding, mild, tearful, but Silicea deeper, more profound, with defective assimilation and suppuration
Lyc dread from actual inability; Silicea dread is imaginary, performs well when forced
Symptomatologies similar, but do not follow each other well; Silicea antidotes some Mercury effects, but as potentized medicines they disagree
Thuja complementary for vaccination effects (high fever, pustular rash); Silicea for later sequelae (convulsions, diarrhoea, abscesses)

cautions: Use with care in phthisis: may cause absorption of scar tissue and liberate walled-in disease to new activity
Danger of repeating in advanced phthisis: may cause suppurative pneumonia if lung is tubercular
Fluoric acid antidotes over-use of Silicea in bone affections
Mercurius does not follow well after Silicea
